title: Construction Workers at Industrial Site, 1970s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white high-angle snapshot depicting two construction workers wearing hard hats wading in shallow water atop a concrete structure. A heavy metallic cylindrical pipe or conduit is suspended from crane cables above them as they align and guide its installation. Reflections ripple across the water-covered concrete surface, framing the busy background of a sprawling construction or municipal infrastructure project under open skies.
